description: tikajs-4c5k: glyphs a gap apart, as a code set letter by letter has them (Helvetica 11, one Tj each, a TJ with kerning numbers, and two fonts). PDFBox puts a space where the gap exceeds min(0.5 x the space width, 0.3 x the average glyph width): 0.139 em for digits and capitals, 0.07 em between narrow letters; pdf.js puts its own at 0.102 em, which split NHS2012D1298E into 'N H S 2 0 1 2 D 1 2 9 8 E'. Apache Tika 4.2.0 (/rmeta/text) for the same bytes, in order: 'NHS2012D1298E' and 'N H S 2 0 1 2 D 1 2 9 8 E' (gaps 0.12 and 0.20 em), 'KME2014D4023G' and 'K M E 2 0 1 4 D 4 0 2 3 G' (TJ), 'ill i i l l i t l' and 'illiillitl' (0.08 and 0.04 em), '12345678' and '1234 5678' (a font change). Written by scripts/make-pdf-repros.ts.
